Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Okta

Dear Hiring Manager,

A newly formed organization needs forecasts and budgets that business leaders can trust from the start, and that depends on a model built around real drivers. At Calder Industrial Components, I rebuilt the forecast model for our larger business unit around order backlog and raised its accuracy from 88% to 96%. Your Technology FP&A role calls for the same discipline: owning budgeting and forecasting and keeping controllable spend accurate.

As a Financial Analyst, I own monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD. That means budget vs. actual variance analysis, regular conversations with business owners about what is driving the numbers, and clean reporting on a deadline. I also automated journal checks in Excel VBA, which shortened our month-end close, so I'm comfortable working with controllership on close processes and evolving them. I build in advanced Excel and Power BI, and I hold a B.S. in Finance. I'm also working toward my ACCA qualification, with 9 of 13 papers passed. I haven't worked on M&A deal models, but I'm a builder who learns quickly and challenges how processes are run, and I'd bring that to your pace and scale.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I could support your Technology leadership team. I'm available to speak at your convenience.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
